title: 第28章 必杀技
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
齐云溪在客厅呆坐了一个多时辰，才收拾心情出门。

    经过院里老榕树下，目光不经意间瞥见东侧一扇半开半掩的门户，她心念一动，转身走上前，轻轻叩了叩门，边小声唤道：“吴师姐？你回来了？”

    少顷，一个装扮艳丽的女子将门彻底拉开，笑道：“齐师妹啊，有事？”

    一股浓郁的脂粉香味钻入鼻腔，齐云溪往屋里瞄了瞄，说道：“打扰师姐了，我有事与师姐请教，不知是否方便？”

    吴今瓶心生诧异，侧身让开道：“进来说吧。”

    进得屋里，入眼到处都是各色好看的衣裙，梳妆台上堆满了姻脂水粉和首饰，齐云溪不敢乱看，移步到桌前，眼观鼻鼻观心。

    吴今瓶随手关了门，又打下禁制，说道：“刚回来，我这有点乱，随便坐。”

    她就斜倚着门墙，双手抱胸，也不泡茶，盯着对方等待问话。

    齐云溪从储物袋里摸出一块灵石放在桌上，道：“一点心意，师姐不要嫌少。”

    吴今瓶微怔，随即嘴角翘起，伸手将灵石摄入手中，然后扭着腰肢上前道：“齐师妹，你我认识快十年了，住同一个院子也有三年，还是头一回做你生意呢！”

    她从储物袋里取出一坛酒和两个干净杯子，笑盈盈道：“我这没炉子烧水煮茶，将就喝点酒吧，有问题尽管问，姐姐我知无不言，言无不尽！”

    齐云溪看了眼桌前的凳子，只用半边屁股坐上去，支支吾吾一时不知如何开口。

    吴今瓶倒了两杯酒，自己先灌下一杯，抿了抿红艳艳的性感嘴唇，乐道：“说啊！你祖爷爷是筑基后期修士，修行相关无需找上我这个炼气六层，要打听男人？还是买什么尖货？”

    齐云溪抬眸瞧去一眼，红着脸道：“我…我是想问，男人去过青楼，多久会再去？”

    吴今瓶脸色略显古怪，好笑道：“这谁说得准，得看人呀，有的人三天两头往那跑，有的人时间久一点，一两个月去一次。”

    眼珠子转了转，她接着道：“不过，沾过腥的猫就没有不再吃鱼的，你喜欢的男人去过青楼？担心他再去？那你自己得下功夫啊，累到他双腿发软，走道都得扶墙，他有心也无力！”

    说罢，吴今瓶掩嘴‘咯咯’娇笑起来，花枝乱颤。

    稍稍止住笑声，她抓起酒坛倒酒，边随口问：“谁啊？”

    齐云溪心中迟疑，想到对方回头一打听也会知道，便如实道：“苏牧。”

    吴今瓶愣了愣，连忙放下酒坛，身子前倾直将桌沿压扁，连续问道：“七号院的那个苏牧？苏执事？什么时候的事？”
content_en:
Qi Yunxi sat in the living room for more than an hour before gathering his mood and going out.

    Passing under the old banyan tree in the courtyard, she inadvertently caught a glimpse of a half-open door on the east side. With a thought in her mind, she turned around and walked forward, gently knocked on the door, and called in a low voice: "Senior Sister Wu? Are you back?"

    After a while, a woman in gorgeous clothes opened the door completely and said with a smile: "Junior Sister Qi, what's the matter?"

    A strong scent of powder penetrated his nose. Qi Yunxi took a look into the room and said, "Sorry to bother you, senior sister. I have something to ask senior sister for advice. Is it convenient?"

    Wu Jinping was surprised, stepped aside and said, "Come in and talk."

    Entering the room, all kinds of beautiful dresses and dresses were everywhere. The dressing table was piled with gouache and jewelry. Qi Yunxi didn't dare to look around. He moved to the table and looked at her nose and heart.

    Wu Jinping closed the door, put down the ban, and said, "I just came back. It's a bit messy here. Sit down wherever you want."

    She just leaned against the door wall, folded her arms, didn't make tea, and stared at the other person, waiting for questions.

    Qi Yunxi took out a spiritual stone from his storage bag and placed it on the table, saying: "A little kindness, senior sister, don't think it's too little."

    Wu Jinping was startled for a moment, then raised the corner of his mouth, stretched out his hand to take the spirit stone into his hand, then twisted his waist and stepped forward: "Junior sister Qi, we have known each other for almost ten years, and have lived in the same courtyard for three years. This is the first time I do business with you!"

    She took out a jar of wine and two clean cups from her storage bag, and said with a smile: "I don't have a stove to boil water and make tea, so I will drink some wine. If you have any questions, just ask. Sister, I will tell you everything I know!"

    Qi Yunxi glanced at the stool in front of the table and sat on it with only half of his buttocks, hesitating and not knowing how to speak.

    Wu Jinping poured two glasses of wine, drank one himself first, sipped his sexy red lips, and said happily: "Tell me! Your grandpa is a late-stage foundation-building monk. There is no need to find me, a sixth-level Qi refining person, for cultivation-related matters. Do you want to inquire about a man? Or buy something top-notch?"

    Qi Yunxi looked up and said with a blush, "I...I want to ask, if a man has been to a brothel, how long will it take for him to go again?"

    Wu Jinping had a slightly weird look on his face and said amusedly: "Who can say for sure? It depends on the person. Some people go there every two days, while some people go there for a longer period of time, once a month or two."

    Rolling her eyes, she continued: "However, no cat that has been exposed to fish will stop eating fish. The man you like has been to a brothel? Are you worried that he will go again? Then you have to work hard. He will be so tired that his legs are weak and he has to hold on to the wall in the aisle. He has no intention of doing it!"

    After saying that, Wu Jinping covered his mouth and started to giggle, making the flower branches tremble.

    After stopping her laughter for a moment, she grabbed the wine jar and poured wine while casually asking: "Who is it?"

    Qi Yunxi hesitated, thinking that the other party would know if he asked around, so he said truthfully: "Su Mu."

    Wu Jinping was stunned, and quickly put down the wine jar, leaned forward and flattened the edge of the table, and asked continuously: "That Su Mu from Courtyard No. 7? Deacon Su? When did it happen?"
